Spring Training Transportation: Getting to Cactus League Games

Scottsdale Sprinters is a Scottsdale chauffeured transportation company serving metro Phoenix. Every February and March, Arizona transforms into baseball heaven. With 15 Cactus League teams across the Valley, getting to games efficiently is half the challenge.

Spring Training Transportation Arizona

Every February and March, Arizona transforms into baseball heaven. With 15 Cactus League teams across the Valley, getting to games efficiently is half the challenge.

The Cactus League Map

East Valley Stadiums

  • Sloan Park (Cubs) - Mesa
  • Hohokam Stadium (A's) - Mesa
  • Salt River Fields (D-backs/Rockies) - Scottsdale
  • Scottsdale Stadium (Giants) - Scottsdale
  • Tempe Diablo Stadium (Angels) - Tempe

West Valley Stadiums

  • Camelback Ranch (Dodgers/White Sox) - Glendale
  • Goodyear Ballpark (Guardians/Reds) - Goodyear
  • Surprise Stadium (Rangers/Royals) - Surprise
  • Peoria Stadium (Mariners/Padres) - Peoria

Central

  • Chase Field (D-backs regular season) - Downtown Phoenix

Why Use Spring Training Transportation?

  • Park once - Hit multiple games in a day
  • No parking stress - Stadium lots fill early
  • Tailgate properly - Drinks aboard are for guests 21 and over only (BYOB; we do not sell alcohol)
  • Beat the snowbirds - Seasonal traffic is brutal
  • Group coordination - Keep fans together

Popular Spring Training Packages

Single Game Experience

4 hours of service (the minimum)

  • Hotel pickup
  • Game drop-off
  • Post-game pickup
  • $500 in the Luxury SUV (up to 6) or $580 in the Executive Black Sprinter (up to 14)

Day-Night Doubleheader

8-10 hours of service

  • Two different stadiums
  • Lunch stop between
  • BYOB for guests 21 and over
  • From $1,015 (Executive Black Sprinter, 8 hours with 7 billed)

Stadium Crawl (Full Day)

10-12 hours of service

  • Visit 3-4 stadiums
  • Catch innings at each
  • True baseball immersion
  • From $1,305 (Executive Black Sprinter, 10 hours with 9 billed)

Game Day Logistics

Arrival Timing

  • Parking lots open: 2-3 hours before first pitch
  • Best arrival: 90 minutes before
  • Standing room lines: 60 minutes before

Post-Game Reality

  • 20-45 minute parking lot exit
  • Limited rideshare availability
  • Our pickup: Designated VIP spot

Vehicle Recommendations

Group SizeVehicleHourly Rate
Up to 6 fansLuxury SUV (Suburban)$125
Up to 14 fansExecutive Black Sprinter$145
Up to 16 fansLimo Party Sprinter (16 Pax)$175
Up to 28 fansParty Bus (28 Pax)$250

There is a 4-hour minimum on most vehicles (5 hours for the 56-Passenger Motorcoach). 7+ hours earns 1 free hour, 12+ earns 2. Prices are before 8% Arizona sales tax. Every rate is on the pricing page.
